definitions.explanation: A person's normal, baseline body temperature when healthy, typically around 36-37°C.

examples.japanese: {平熱|へいねつ}に{戻|もど}った。
examples.english: My temperature went back to normal.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{平熱|へいねつ}は36.2{度|ど}です。
examples.english: My normal body temperature is 36.2 degrees.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}んだら{熱|ねつ}が{下|さ}がって{平熱|へいねつ}になった。
examples.english: After taking medicine, my fever went down and returned to normal.

notes:
FORMATION:
{平|へい} (normal, ordinary) + {熱|ねつ} (heat, temperature).

USAGE:
Commonly used in medical and everyday health contexts. In Japan, body temperature is measured in Celsius. Normal temperature ({平熱|へいねつ}) is generally considered to be around 36°C to 37°C.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平熱|へいねつ}に{戻|もど}る (to return to normal temperature)
- {平熱|へいねつ}より{高|たか}い (higher than normal temperature)

CONTRAST:
- {高熱|こうねつ} (high fever)
- {微熱|びねつ} (slight fever)
- {発熱|はつねつ} (onset of fever)
